reuse.why: Uses the shared getMonthWideCategories selection, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable wiring; no helper existed for the income guard or sign flip.

duplication.why: Copies the per-action income guard (`is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()`) and writes its own sign flip, the same inline pattern each existing month-wide action repeats, rather than factoring it.

placement.why: Action lives in budget/actions.ts beside its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts like the others.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and its tests.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the established pattern and easy to read, though it adds one more copy of the guard to keep in sync.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied income guard is a verbatim repeat of the sibling pattern, not disguised.
